title: Dative and Spatial Cases on Plural Possessed Nouns

sections.content:
Other case endings stack naturally after the plural possession suffix:
- **Dative (-nak/-nek):** *szüleimnek* (to/for my parents)
- **Inessive (-ban/-ben):** *a könyveimben* (in my books), *a gondolataimban* (in my thoughts)
- **Superessive (-on/-en/-ön):** *a polcaimon* (on my shelves)
- **Allative (-hoz/-hez/-höz):** *a rokonaimhoz* (to my relatives)

items.spanish: Szép virágot vettem a szüleimnek ajándékba.
items.english: I bought nice flowers for my parents as a gift.

items.spanish: A legfontosabb gondolataimat a jegyzeteimben találom.
items.english: I find my most important thoughts in my notes.

items.spanish: Hétvégén a vidéki rokonainkhoz utazunk látogatóba.
items.english: On the weekend we travel to our countryside relatives for a visit.
